```{r}
#| label: met-demographics
#| include: false

demographic_variables <- c(
  "demo_age", "sex", "Race", "Ethnicity", "weight_kg", 
  "leit3_nv_iq", "cgis_soi_fct", "Molecular.Category"
)

demographic_labels <- list(
  "demo_age" = "Age (years)", 
  "sex" = "Sex", 
  "Race" = "Race", 
  "Ethnicity" = "Ethnicity", 
  "weight_kg" = "Weight (kg)", 
  "leit3_nv_iq" = "IQ",
  "cgis_soi_fct" = "CGIS Severity of Illness", 
  "Molecular.Category" = "Molecular Category"
)

demog_tbl <- data |> 
  dplyr::filter(
    redcap_event_name == "Baseline Visit (Visit 1)"
  ) |> 
  gtsummary::tbl_summary(
    by = Treatment,
    label = demographic_labels,
    type = c(demo_age, weight_kg, leit3_nv_iq) ~ "continuous",
        statistic = c(demo_age, weight_kg, leit3_nv_iq) ~ c("{mean} ({sd})"),
    include = dplyr::all_of(demographic_variables),
    digits = list(c(demo_age, weight_kg, leit3_nv_iq) ~ c(1, 1, 0, 0, 0)),
    missing_text = "Missing"
  ) |> 
  gtsummary::add_overall() |> 
  gtsummary::add_p(
    pvalue_fun = gtsummary::label_style_pvalue(digits = 3)
  ) |> 
  gtsummary::separate_p_footnotes() |> 
      gtsummary::modify_table_body(
        ~ .x |> 
          dplyr::filter(
            !(row_type == "level" & 
                dplyr::if_all(
                  .cols = gtsummary::all_stat_cols(), 
                  ~ .x == "0 (0%)"
                )
              )
          )
      )

demog_tbl_stratified <- data |> 
  dplyr::filter(
    redcap_event_name == "Baseline Visit (Visit 1)"
  ) |> 
  gtsummary::tbl_strata(
    strata = Treatment,
    .tbl_fun = ~ .x |> 
      gtsummary::tbl_summary(
        by = Site,
        label = demographic_labels,
        include = dplyr::all_of(demographic_variables)
      ) |> 
      gtsummary::modify_table_body(
        ~ .x |> 
          dplyr::filter(
            !(row_type == "level" & 
                dplyr::if_all(
                  .cols = gtsummary::all_stat_cols(), 
                  ~ .x == "0 (0%)"
                )
              )
          )
      )
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-demograpic
#| tbl-cap: "Characteristics of the study cohort, all three sites combined, by treatment."

demog_tbl |> 
  gtsummary::as_flex_table() |> 
  flextable::width(width = demog_tbl_width)
```

\

```{r}
#| label: tbl-demographic-stratified
#| tbl-cap: "Characteristics of the study cohort by study site and treatment."

demog_tbl_stratified |> 
  gtsummary::as_flex_table() |> 
  flextable::width(width = stratified_tbl_width)
```
